t: This is the area of Hatcham Barn Manor, a former manorial estate in Deptford, in Kent as it was then. Little is recorded in the material I have, but two owners are named. One is Brihtsige, an English nobleman of the eleventh century. The other is Odo, Earl of Kent, a Norman nobleman who was bishop of Bayeux and half-brother of William the Conqueror. He was made Earl of Kent after the Conquest, and is likely to have commissioned the Bayeux Tapestry.
